exact_statement: Let g_+,g_- be Boolean functions on the same finite uniform data cube X, beta an independent quadratic F2 Boolean phase on Z, F=g_beta, p=Pr(beta=+1), d=Pr(g_+!=g_-), J=I(g_+g_-), and Q_+,Q_- any normalized full references supporting their spectra. Keep the ORIGINAL Q=pQ_+ +(1-p)Q_- fixed. For every predetermined exposed E, the unchanged inherited reference Q times C_(Z\E), C=(1-d)delta_empty+dP_beta, has average full cost CE(pP_+ +(1-p)P_-,Q)+H(C_(Z\E)) <=Gamma_bar+4J+2I_(Z\E)(F). For ANY finite adaptive control-only query/stopping tree, give each node alpha Q times [(1-d)delta_empty+d Uniform(V_alpha)], where V_alpha is the actual restricted quadratic phase affine Fourier support. This phase law is obtained by conditioning the ORIGINAL projected affine phase source onto V_alpha. Each return from its inherited marginalized reference decreases the full cost by exactly D(C_alpha||C_inherited)>=0. At every physical stopping frontier, average full cost <=Gamma_bar+4J+2 average remaining control influence. If beta is nonconstant and the ORIGINAL terminal full costs are <=cI(g_s), c<=143/16, the SAME original rate25 account retains at least I_X(F)/16+23 average remaining control influence after all old signed debits and exact return credits. Constant beta uses its single selected terminal reference. No individual-child nonnegative bank or positive-only booking is asserted. Indeed beta=(-1)^(z1z2), g_+=1,g_-=-1 gives a positive-only overdraft of1/2 for every rate K>=2; its adaptive stop-constant/query-character tree has final unchanged-reference cost1/2 at zero influence, cleared by the prescribed original-fiber return.
hypotheses: Uniform independent finite cubes X,Z; g_+,g_- arbitrary Boolean on the SAME X; beta degree<=2 over F2 on Z.
Q_+,Q_- complete normalized references supporting the respective full spectra, including empty atoms; both physical branch bills retained.

The no-reset theorem requires E fixed independently of physical outcomes. The adaptive theorem requires the explicitly prescribed original-phase affine-fiber returns, with all exact KL credits booked.
Only control coordinates queried, at most once on a path; arbitrary finite adaptive choices/stopping. Data reference Q remains its original root mixture.
Rate25 corollary additionally assumes ORIGINAL full terminal payment <=cI with c<=143/16. No repeated 16I_X grant and no ignoring negative credits.
